About 4 to 5 metres down the corridor to the right, and roughly 3.5 to 4 metres behind the person in red, a second person in a dark hoodie stands near a glass wall facing sideways and away from the camera wearer. Across the five frames, the camera wearer turns left and advances toward the doorway into the sunlit room, causing the person in red to exit the right edge of the frame by the second frame and both people along with the corridor and bins to pass completely out of view to the right by the third and fourth frames. As the camera wearer approaches the room entrance in frames three through five, the open glass door shifts to the right side of the view to within arm's reach (about 0.8 to 1.2 metres away), partially occluding a leaning mirror and yellow ball behind it, while an angled exercise bench in the center-right of the room (about 2.5 to 3.5 metres away) and white shelving units beneath the windows roughly 2 metres behind the bench (4.5 to 5.5 metres from the camera wearer) come into clear view.
